notes: §2002:8.4.2.2.3 GR5: a function not found sets EC-PROGRAM-NOT-FOUND, the function is not activated (EC-FUNCTION-NOT-FOUND is the §2014 name). The activation site passes the edition's name (ExceptionCatalog.NameInEdition) and states that it is a function activation (asFunction), because the runtime no longer reads function-ness off the name. Not observable from a golden (the miss ends the run unit); the termination test names EC-PROGRAM-NOT-FOUND at 2002 and EC-FUNCTION-NOT-FOUND at 2014.
